mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure in a tight monetary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure in tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% in a month and industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% in 1 month and INDPRO > 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
